JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Label: Darkness Slider
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Hint: Show a quick darkness level slider in the Lighting layer controls, so you can adjust scene darkness without opening the scene config.
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Label: Darkness Slider — Update Mode
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Hint: Controls when the darkness change is applied to the scene. Real-time updates on every drag move; On Apply only saves when you click the Apply button.
JSD.Settings.DarknessSlider.Mode.Apply: On Apply (updates when you click Apply)
JSD.DarknessPanel.Title: Darkness Level
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Label: Apply Scene Defaults to New Scenes
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Hint: When enabled, new scenes are created with the values defined in your Scene Defaults configuration. Imported scenes (adventure packs, compendiums) are not affected.
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Name: Scene Defaults
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Label: Configure Scene Defaults
JSD.Settings.SceneDefaults.Menu.Hint: Open the Scene configuration editor to define default values applied to every new scene you create.
JSD.SceneDefaults.Saved: Scene defaults saved! New scenes will use these settings.
